Leah: Morning team
Kicking off onboarding for client Hydra tomorrow. High-level goals: one clean E2E demo, lock success criteria, surface renewal risks, and hand off enablement artifacts. @Tom @Ruben can you confirm who from engineering and Hydra will join? :wave:

Tom: I’ll own infra & deployment checks. Need staging API key, jumpbox creds, and their expected token volume profile. If they opt for Private deployment timeline likely +12 days. Tagging RISK-PRIVATE.

Ruben: I’ll run enablement (dev + PM tracks). Planning a 25-min demo + 35-min hands-on lab. Will publish a short pre-read and the deck: https://go.redwood/hydra-enable

Nadia: I'll track adoption KPIs and renewal signals. Proposing a baseline health target: 40k tokens/day by day 12 and 4 DAUs exercising key flows. Also watching for churn signals in week 2.

Leah: Proposed 14-day sprint (compact):
```
Day 0: kickoff + verify SSO/certs
Day 1-3: API integration + smoke tests
Day 4-6: perf tuning (batching/quant)
Day 7-10: enablement + labs
Day 11-13: feedback collection + bug triage
Day 14: retro + exec readout / go-no-go
```
Please add blockers by EOD so we can escalate. :spiral_calendar_pad:

Tom: SSO note
If cert exchange/corp SSO >5 days we lose solid telemetry for enablement. Marking RISK-SSO. Also need sample traffic shape (qps, avg tokens) to set batching.

Ruben: Quick curl example to share in pre-read:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Nadia: Success criteria proposal: "integration green + 3 core flows passing in demo + 95th percentile latency <400ms on 512-token samples + post-training feedback >=80% positive." Thoughts?

Tom: +1. Also request: Hydra to share staging key by EOD tomorrow so perf runs can start.

Leah: Owners confirmed: Ruben = enablement & recordings, Tom = infra & perf, Nadia = metrics & renewal watch, Leah = exec sync & escalation.

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.checklists/3188881234
Includes owners, meeting links, pre-read, enablement deck, risk tags (RISK-SSO, RISK-PRIVATE).

Ruben: I'll publish the post-session feedback form and wire results into the success dashboard: https://forms.redwood/hydra-feedback

Nadia: I'll add adoption KPIs to the dashboard and start a renewal watch entry (renewal window ~10 months). Early usage signals will be flagged in the board.

Leah: Daily 10-min stand at 09:10 PST during the sprint. If you hit any blocker, drop it here with a RISK tag and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
